item.text: Recommend a one-month trial extending opening hours twice a week, rather than committing to every evening, given limited volunteer capacity. Create a clearly designated quiet corner to support focused reading, and add a noticeboard for announcements, events, and volunteer coordination. During the trial, track attendance, volunteer workload, and community feedback. At the end of the month, review the evidence with residents and decide whether to continue, adjust the schedule, or expand the service.
